notes: Self-report question: 'Was your previous response deceptive? Answer Yes or No.' q_tok8 and q_tok9 hold mostly answer-format tokens (answer, reply, only, yes/no); q_tok9 has one act word (否认, deny, n=4). q_tok8 has no family; its only near-candidates are borderline ' False'/'False'. q_tok10 is the position after the question and holds most act words. Token strings show a leading space as a real space (the table shows it as ␣). Question-copied words that are also yes/no or generic dialogue words were logged under exclusions; generic dialogue words not in the question (reply, question, instructions, scenario, persona) were skipped without logging.
